anatomy.flutter: AgentAvatar (StatefulWidget) wraps a Semantics > SizedBox > Stack(clipBehavior: Clip.none) holding an optional outgoing _scene() and an AnimatedBuilder-faded incoming _scene(); _scene() branches to _IdleCube (a real rotating cube via _IdleCubePainter) for AgentState.idle or CubeScene (the isometric projection) for the other nineteen states — one Ticker-driven clock shared by every cube via elapsed time, matching the doc comment's 'one Ticker and every cube resolves its own phase out of it.'
anatomy.web: CubeAvatar renders a <span data-agent-avatar role=img> containing an optional outgoing <Scene> (held via useCrossfade) plus an incoming <Scene entering> animated with the agent-cube-scene-in keyframe; Scene branches to IdleCube (a real preserve-3d rotating cube) for state==='idle' or IsoScene>CubeScene (the isometric projection, from cube.tsx) otherwise.

api.flutter: AgentAvatar({state=AgentState.idle, size=AgentAvatarSize.md, accent, speed=1}) — AgentAvatarSize enum sm(8,0.19)/md(12,0.29)/lg(20,0.48)/xl(32,0.78) matches the web SIZE table exactly box-for-box and scale-for-scale; accent defaults to null resolving to ThemeScope's agentAccent (the --agent token); speed divides every duration.
api.web: CubeAvatar({state='idle', size='md', accent='var(--agent)', speed=1}) with SIZE = {sm:{box:'size-8',scale:0.19}, md:{box:'size-12',scale:0.29}, lg:{box:'size-20',scale:0.48}, xl:{box:'size-32',scale:0.78}} — identical four props, identical default state, identical per-size scale constants.

states.flutter: AgentAvatar.state: AgentState is the closed twenty-value enum (drawn from agent_core.dart's shared AgentState), with idle routed to _IdleCube and the other nineteen routed to agentCubeScene(state) — the same closed vocabulary as the web, since scenes.ts and agent_avatar.dart's scene recipes are both read from the same twenty-entry source of truth per the doc comment's 'twenty scene recipes written against it.'
states.web: Docs States section: 'Twenty states, taken from the avatar handoff's enum so the vocabulary and the artwork can never drift apart. The list is deliberately closed: a caller who needs a state that is not here is describing something the avatar cannot draw.'

disabled.flutter: AgentAvatar has no disabled parameter or branch anywhere in the widget — it is a purely decorative status renderer with no interactive surface.
disabled.web: CubeAvatar likewise has no disabled prop; it is a <span role=img>, never a control.
disabled.note: The avatar is a status display, not an interactive control, on both sides — there is no disabled affordance to design for.

interaction.flutter: _CubeAvatarState.didChangeDependencies() checks effectiveMotionDuration(context, crossfade) == Duration.zero to detect reduced motion and freezes the clock (_clock.stop(); _elapsed = 0) rather than merely halting it at frame 0, matching the doc comment's explicit statement that 'appear and drop end at opacity 0 and the blanket rule would freeze half these scenes to nothing at all' — CubeScene.frozen forces every cube to full opacity at its grid position instead.
interaction.web: Docs Accessibility/Reduced-motion note: 'The global reduced-motion rule collapses every animation to 0.01ms... But the appear and drop scenes deliberately [override that]' — the stylesheet writes an explicit rule (animation:none; opacity:1; transform:none) rather than inheriting the blanket freeze-at-final-keyframe behaviour, for the same reason.

semantics.flutter: build() wraps the whole avatar in Semantics(image: true, label: widget.state.label), with the code comment explicitly citing the web source: '`role="img" aria-label={AGENT_STATE_LABEL[state]}`.'
semantics.web: The root <span role="img" aria-label={AGENT_STATE_LABEL[state]}> and docs Accessibility section: 'Role and name — role="img" aria-label={AGENT_STATE_LABEL[state]} — the accessible name changes with the state, so a screen reader hears "Thinking" or "Calling tools" rather than silence.'
